newsitem.title: USA: CCC buys 85,000 tonnes U.S. corn for North Korea.
newsitem.headline: CCC buys 85,000 tonnes U.S. corn for North Korea.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp said it bought a total of 85,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn for donation to North Korea.
The shipment period was slated for August 1-September 10.
The corn was divided into three lots. One lot of 46,000 tonnes was bought from Cargill Inc, Minneapolis, at $108.45 a tonne FOB.
A second lot of 24,750 tonnes was bought from Continental Grain Co, Tacoma, Wash., at $119.72 a tonne, FOB.
The third lot of 14,250 tonnes was purchased from Continental Grain Co, Chicago at $108.71 a tonne, FOB.
